description: Make this a much younger seedling at the very start of its life: a single short slender stem barely taller than the root flare, carrying only two or three small leaves near the tip, with the root flare small and low. Keep the identical art style, the same warm brown bark, the same sage-green leaf colour, the same soft brown outline, the same low camera angle, and the same transparent background with no soil, no grass and no ground.
